about: API-3 scope (API-STANDARD S33-S36). Curated by cb-api with the owning area. money_writes: routes that move or record money; each must require an Idempotency-Key. inbound: routes that take a peer's or a webhook's JSON; each must schema-check it before use. money_reviewed_not: routes whose path looks like money but that write nothing (a preview, a build). public_ids: routes whose path value S35 does not apply to, each with its reason: public by design (a public door, a counterparty door, platform reference), or a label or reference that names nothing outside the caller's own shop (a fiscal year, a per-shop reference); foreign_id_404 (S35) does not apply to them. tools/api-register.cjs --check fails when a mutating route that looks like money is in none of the lists.
machine_keyed_about: CON-ERP-IDEM (Athi 11 Nov 2026): a keyed machine door is a money write whose caller (an agent we do not redeploy) cannot send an Idempotency-Key header. It dedupes by its own key_order instead, and S36 idempotent_money_write passes it ONLY while its test file proves the six cases (K1 same payload once, K2 two payloads two chits, K3 a failed emit is 503 and the retry creates the chit, K4 a stale pending receipt is claimed again, K5 the header key beats the hash, K6 the same key with another body is 422). A listed route whose test is missing or does not carry them fails tools/api-register.cjs --check.

machine_keyed.reason: keyed machine door; the kit cannot send Idempotency-Key; revisit at the next kit release

platform_only_about: platform_only: routes only the platform (admin key, rootGate, platformGate) or the builder can call, each with its reason. They are NOT public: no shop ever reaches the id, so foreign_id_404 (S35) does not apply, exactly as for public_ids. Read by tools/api-register.cjs hardeningScope; tools/api-register.cjs --check holds the same rules as public_ids (reason of 20+ characters, a route that exists).

cannot_answer_about: error_tests exemption (API-STANDARD S33-S38, critic 6 Nov 2026 section 5): a status a route declares (the register implies 404 on every route with a : in its path, and 500 on every route) but can never answer, so no test can ever show it. Each entry names a route, the status and the reason; reviewed by cb-api. Read only by the error_tests column; status_codes is judged as before.

cannot_answer.reason: the answer is one frozen constant object read from memory with no query; the only fault left is Express itself failing to write, which no request can provoke, so no test can show a 500

tolerant_outward_about: S33-T (Athi 11 Nov 2026, 'tolerant by design'): a door that outside systems or queued clients call may ignore an unknown body key. An entry is { reason (20+ characters), caller_class (queued_till | queued_web_outbox | provider_webhook | ctp_delivery | record_as_body | desktop_connector | keyed_outward), test (a file that names the route, sends zz_unknown and expects the problem shape) }. Every known key of its body schema must be typed (tools/api-register.cjs knownKeysTyped). The register reads strict_input as exempt (never yes). Athi 12 Nov 2026: the class may GROW for outward doors another system or a queued client calls (never for a door our own web calls); an unknown key is accepted and logged by name once (event unknown_key_accepted, middleware/validate.js noteUnknownKeys), never used. The list changes only with these proofs and never passes tolerant_outward_ceiling.

POST /api/integrations/heartbeat.reason: S33-T: the desktop connector's heartbeat, sent by installed software on older and newer kits; the handler picks named keys only, every known key is typed and counters is bounded (20 whole-number counters)

POST /api/integrations/profile.reason: S33-T: the desktop connector copies profile fields; fields are filtered to the profile map's own keys, any other key is dropped

PATCH /api/products/:id.reason: S33-T: the web outbox queues product edits on the shop owner's device and replays them after an app update; an entry written by an older page may carry a key this server no longer names, and refusing it would strand the whole queue

POST /api/products/availability/bulk.reason: S33-T: a connector's stock feed (ERP or desktop software on older versions) posts the list under items; an extra key beside it must not stop the feed

POST /api/connectors/ingest.reason: S33-T: a Pi or gateway on a kit we do not redeploy; it keeps an event until a 2xx, so an unknown key is ignored and a known key of the wrong kind is refused before the key check

POST /api/connectors/erp-ingest.reason: S33-T: an ERP agent on a kit we do not redeploy; process-then-forget, an unknown key is ignored and never stored; a known key of the wrong kind is refused before the key check

POST /api/capture/webhook/whatsapp.reason: S33-T: Meta owns the payload keys; only a SIGNED body is read, an unknown key is ignored, the keys we read are typed from Meta published payload examples

POST /api/capture/webhook/email.reason: S33-T: the mail provider owns the fields; only a SIGNED body is read, an unknown field is ignored, the fields we read are typed as Mailgun and SendGrid publish them

POST /api/events/ticket.reason: S33-T: asked by the app, the till, the shop screen and the connector (key scopes, some on cached older builds); it reads no body key at all, so any key is ignored

POST /api/ctp/deliver.reason: S33-T / RAIL-126: CTP/1 inbound is a tolerant reader; a peer on a higher minor may add fields, to and from are typed as objects and the later checks keep their own words

POST /api/ctp/query.reason: S33-T / RAIL-126: CTP/1 inbound is a tolerant reader; a peer on a higher minor may add fields, from and ask are typed as objects and the later checks keep their own words

POST /api/till/flags.reason: S33-T: a shop-screen or offer flag the counter queues offline; an older queued body replays on a newer server, so an unknown key is ignored and only a wrong KIND of value is refused (400, parked by the drain)

POST /api/till/stock.reason: S33-T: an available/unavailable mark the counter queues offline; unknown keys ignored, null for none accepted, a wrong kind refused 400 (the drain parks that row and sends the rest)

POST /api/till/stock/bulk.reason: S33-T: the bulk stock mark rides the same offline queue as stock; unknown keys ignored, item_ids must be a list or null, a wrong kind refused 400

POST /api/till/reward.reason: S33-T: points for one bill, queued behind the bill; the desktop agent (tools/tally-connector/till.js) still sends net, gross, count and lines, which stay accepted and unread; a wrong kind refused 400

POST /api/till/reward/claim.reason: S33-T: a walk-in balance claim, sent through the counter queue; unknown keys ignored, from and to must be objects, a wrong kind refused 400

POST /api/till/quick-keys/hide.reason: S33-T: the first counter versions queued sold-out marks (e5fe6136) so an old queued body can replay; was closed (additionalProperties false), now tolerant; a wrong kind refused 400

POST /api/till/quick-keys/unhide.reason: S33-T: the first counter versions queued the put-back (e5fe6136) so an old queued body can replay; was closed (additionalProperties false), now tolerant; a wrong kind refused 400

POST /api/chits/send.reason: S33-T: the counter bill queue door (the sale itself); its five known keys are typed, any other key is read by name or ignored; a refused bill is parked and shown, never dropped

PUT /api/testing/cmdb/:ci.reason: S33-T: the body IS the CMDB record (lib/cmdb.js shape); a key beyond system, title and source travels inside the record, is never acted on, and the record is capped at 64 KB; the three named keys are typed, a junk value is refused 400

POST /api/testing/results.reason: S33-T: the Testing screen and the CI key post a result or a run of them; an unknown key is ignored and never stored, every named key is text or null, a junk value is refused 400 in the board's two keys

POST /api/testing/results/junit.reason: S33-T: the JUnit report travels as the text of xml beside run options; the CI key and the toolset post it from older and newer scripts, so an unknown key is ignored; xml and every option are text, a junk value is refused 400

POST /api/governance/conformance.reason: S33-T: the handler takes the whole body as the thing to check when data is absent, so the body is the record; scope is text and data an object, a junk value is refused 422, the key itself is never stored
